references.name: SlotContrast
references.verified_behavior: Slot_Slot_Contrastive_Loss L2-normalizes slots, uses adjacent-frame dot-product logits divided by temperature (.1 default), and identity correspondence cross-entropy; batch_contrast concatenates objects across batch.
references.borrowed: Normalized object descriptors and explicit temporal contrastive supervision.
references.not_transferred: Slot index as target correspondence, slot network, implicit other-object negatives, reconstruction decoder. Our bbox IDs and explicit background candidates replace those assumptions.
references.venue_evidence: Official repository README states CVPR2025 Oral; this audit verifies code, not infrared efficacy.

references.name: S2MVP
references.verified_behavior: single_stage.py augments detector loss with target-aware auxiliary reconstruction; build_target_obj filters bbox width/height <=64 and constructs object maps.
references.borrowed: Concept of object-directed auxiliary supervision for weak infrared targets.
references.not_transferred: Semisupervised pseudolabeling, ConvGRU/prototype system, FCOS or bbox<=64 rule.
references.venue_evidence: Official README supplies TGRS2025 volume63 pages1-15 DOI10.1109/TGRS.2025.3525648.

references.name: TrackMAE
references.verified_behavior: Pretraining engine derives trajectory displacement targets from CoTracker tracks; model outputs pixel and trajectory predictions with separate MSE terms and a configured coefficient.
references.borrowed: Separation of temporal target construction from model prediction and explicit temporal learning objectives.
references.not_transferred: CoTracker-generated training targets, ViT/MAE network, pixel reconstruction, pretrained weights.
references.venue_evidence: Official repository README identifies CVPR2026 and arXiv2603.27268.

references.name: DeepPro
references.verified_behavior: Original detector.forward returns conv_out1 feature tensor and conv_out2 logits; conv_out1 reduces32to8channels and includes BN+ReLU.
references.borrowed: Frozen original detector definition and its existing F/logits interface.
references.not_transferred: No detector output replacement, inference auxiliary modules or changed normalization.

implementation_boundary: Sources archived and read for design reference; no external networks or training code imported into this experiment. Loss modules are local implementations; actual component matching reuses the frozen local matcher.
